mapper.select: SELECT app_user.user_id, app_user.login_id, app_user.password_hash, app_user.user_name, app_user.email, app_user.organization_id, organization.organization_name, app_role.role_code FROM app_user INNER JOIN organization ON organization.organization_id = app_user.organization_id AND organization.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN user_role ON user_role.user_id = app_user.user_id AND user_role.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN app_role ON app_role.role_id = user_role.role_id AND app_role.is_deleted = 0 AND app_role.role_code = 'GREENFOOD_ADMIN' WHERE app_user.login_id = #{loginId} AND app_user.active_yn = 'Y' AND app_user.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = user_id WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
